PM Modi urges youth to connect with border villages

Prime Minister Narendra Modi has urged young people to visit border villages to understand India better, rather than relying on virtual means. He stated that when youth connect directly with the nation's challenges and opportunities, the country's future becomes stronger. Modi interacted with 5,000 MYBharat volunteers from border villages. He also advised government ministries to be youthful, dynamic, and adaptable, emphasizing the need for young entrepreneurs' participation in key sectors and industry-aligned courses.
